name: James River Semiconductor, Inc
old_description: James River Semiconductor maintains one of the largest inventories of parts for your facility.
about:
James River Semiconductor, Inc. operates from Richmond, Virginia. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in public sources.

The business maintains a broad inventory of spare parts and equipment for semiconductor fabrication facilities. Its catalog spans seven categories: valves and flow control, motors/electrical/controls, pumps and fluid handling spares, sensors and process instrumentation, facilities and abatement equipment, gas delivery and regulation, and general facilities spares. At the time of review, 65 products were listed as in stock and six as out of stock.

The company serves semiconductor manufacturers and facility operators that require replacement components for process tools and support systems. Example product lines include Lam Research RF match and ESC assemblies, as well as Air Products Gas Guard 250 units.

James River Semiconductor emphasizes inventory depth and speed: it advertises one of the largest parts inventories for semiconductor facilities and states that all items ship within seven days with domestic ground shipping included.
